bundle.title: Bump the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory with 2 updates
bundle.body:
Bumps the npm_and_yarn group with 2 updates in the /packages/gp-webapp directory: [maplibre-gl](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) and [csv-parse](https://github.com/adaltas/node-csv/tree/HEAD/packages/csv-parse). Updates `maplibre-gl` from 4.7.1 to 6.12.0
Release notes

Sourced from maplibre-gl's releases.

v6.12.0

✨ Features and improvements

  • Add a zoomToUserAccuracy option to GeolocateControlOptions to allow control over map zoom adjustments in line with the Geolocation Position update accuracy, while trackUserLocation is true (#7908, #8324, continues #7909) (by @​timsluis)
  • With fill-extrusion-rounded-corner-distance set, shade the walls of a rounded corner as one curved surface by sharing the vertex normal between walls that meet at a shallow angle, instead of one flat shade per arc segment (#8475) (by @​clement-igonet)
  • Speed up symbol rendering when the set of visible tiles changes, by rewriting the opacity buffers only of the symbol buckets whose labels actually changed instead of every bucket of every symbol layer (#8434) (by @​cherenkov)
  • Add an absolutePadding option to Map#cameraForBounds and Map#fitBounds to treat padding as the map's persistent padding instead of adding it to the current one (#8480) (by @​sargunv)

🐞 Bug fixes

  • fix(CanvasSource): catch load errors and fire map.error like ImageSource (#8448) (#8450) (by @​SatvikMishra08)
  • Fix GeoJSONSource still sending its waiting updates to the worker after the source is removed (#8585) (by @​clementperon)
  • Fix GeoJSONSource memory growing until the page crashes when setData is called faster than the worker handles it (#8585) (by @​clementperon)
  • Fix the map rendering at the display rate instead of going idle over a DEM with a minimum below sea level when centerClampedToGround is false (#8605) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix a gesture over terrain throwing the camera when the terrain under the center loads after the gesture begins or the terrain switches off before it ends (#8548) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix the terrain elevation reading 0 outside the drawn tiles while the camera is below the terrain, and make that read about 40 times cheaper (#8539) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix a hole around the poles of the globe in background, fill and line layers from zoom 3 (#8638) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix jumpTo, and the setters that use it, pulling the center elevation onto the terrain when centerClampedToGround is false (#8566) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix GeoJSONSource#updateData leaving stale clusters on untouched tiles after clustering was turned on with setClusterOptions (#8613) (by @​clementperon)
  • Fix GeoJSONSource#setClusterOptions clustering twice when called while new data is waiting to be sent (#8613) (by @​clementperon)
  • Fix GeoJSONSource data set with setData being overwritten by the result of an earlier URL load or updateData (#8613) (by @​clementperon)
  • Fix fill-extrusion walls facing exactly east or west skipping fill-extrusion-vertical-gradient and rendering brighter than the other walls (#8604) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix easeTo and flyTo pulling the center elevation onto the terrain when centerClampedToGround is false (#8566) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix fill-outline-color, and the antialiased edge of fills, not being drawn when terrain is enabled (#4200) (by @​clement-igonet)
  • Respect map padding when constraining the camera to max bounds, so the padded viewport can pan fully to its edges (#8501) (by @​erenbati)
  • Fix an unclosed disallowed tag in one attribution erasing the other attributions, by sanitizing each attribution before joining them (#8569) (by @​sx4im)
  • Fix color-relief with a custom DEM encoding whose redFactor, greenFactor or blueFactor is 0, where every elevation stop packed to NaN and the color ramp collapsed (#6411) (by @​drakeo338)
  • Fix queryRenderedFeatures missing fill-extrusions on globe once it renders as mercator (#8560) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix line-offset distorting the line width around joins (#8570) (by @​HarelM)
  • Cross-fade raster tiles when zooming out from a source's maxzoom, where the tiles switched instantly (#8517) (by @​cherenkov)

v6.11.2

✨ Features and improvements

  • Improve rendering performance by uploading each tile's projection data once per frame instead of before every draw call (#8545) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Support multiple glyph variants in requests, caches, and atlases (#8488) (by @​NEKOYASAN)

🐞 Bug fixes

  • Fix Map#once(type, layerId, listener) unsubscribing on the first event that misses the layer instead of the first event that hits it (#8499) (by @​cherenkov)
  • Remove hillshade gradient toward the poles (#8551) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix camera settings being undone during camera movement with terrain or transformCameraUpdate (#8550) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix zooming and panning with the pointer above the horizon moving the map in the opposite direction (#8544) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Fix the camera jumping when a drag over terrain ends at a pitch above 84° (#8541) (by @​birkskyum)
  • Ease the center elevation over terrain during easeTo and flyTo instead of holding it and jumping when the animation ends (#8543) (by @​johncarmack1984)
  • Fix fitBounds and cameraForBounds throwing on the globe projection when the padding exceeds the viewport, instead of warning and returning undefined as on mercator (#8538) (by @​drakeo338)
  • Keep raster tiles sharp at a fractional devicePixelRatio, where the canvas covered a different number of device pixels than its backing store held and the compositor rescaled it (#1590) (by @​zdila)

... (truncated)

findings.body:
The root `package-lock.json` still records `maplibre-gl@4.7.1` and `csv-parse@6.2.1`, but `package.json` now declares `^6.12.0` and `^7.0.3` respectively. CI runs `npm ci` (`.github/actions/setup-node-workspace/action.yml`), which exits with a sync error when `package.json` and `package-lock.json` are out of sync — it does not regenerate the lockfile. Every CI job for this PR will fail at the install step.

Falsification check: the lockfile was confirmed to still contain the old resolved versions (lines ~37562 and ~27582); no alternative install path in CI bypasses `npm ci`.

Bumping maplibre-gl two major versions (v4 → v6) with no application code changes risks runtime breakage. Specific concerns:

1. **`event.points` removed**: `VoterMapCanvas.tsx:885` accesses `event.points.length` on touch events — maplibre-gl v5 changed the `MapTouchEvent` shape, so `event.points` may be `undefined`, causing a `TypeError` on every mobile touch interaction.
2. **CSS path changed**: Both `VoterMapCanvas.tsx` and `ContactListMap.tsx` import `maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css` — maplibre-gl v5+ ships CSS at `maplibre-gl/maplibre-gl.css` (no `dist/` prefix), which would produce a module-not-found build error.
3. **`@deck.gl/mapbox` compatibility**: The `MapboxOverlay` is cast via `as unknown as maplibregl.IControl` — the v6 `IControl` interface may have additional required members the overlay doesn't implement.

Falsification check: the lockfile confirms v6 has never been installed or type-checked against this codebase; no optional-chaining guard exists on `event.points`; no code changes accompany this version bump.

output.summary: Dependabot bumps maplibre-gl ^4→^6 and csv-parse ^6→^7 in package.json, but the root package-lock.json was not regenerated — `npm ci` in CI will fail immediately. Beyond the lockfile issue, the two-major-version maplibre-gl jump has no accompanying code changes and risks runtime breakage (touch event API, CSS import path, deck.gl overlay compatibility). csv-parse v7 is safe (no actual breaking changes per its changelog).
